en: <FullPlayerName> has brought an end to his ongoing nightmare at <TeamName> by today announcing his intention to quit the club in search of pastures new.\n<PlayerName> handed in a transfer request to <ManagerName> and is expected to be the subject of a bidding war between several clubs in the days ahead.\n<PlayerName>, who has had a difficult relationship with his adoptive home ever since moving to <TeamName>, has been the subject of tabloid speculation for some time and his decision to try and finally push through a move will come as no surprise to many.

"<PlayerName> has had a difficult first season at <TeamName> after his move this year. ""I've been under a lot of pressure since arriving at the club, mostly from the fans, but I know <ManagerName> picked me to join the club for a reason. I just have to dig deep and help turn the fans frowns upside down"" grinned the player. <ManagerName> added ""He knows what he has to do its just a matter of raising the bar and successfully leaping over it which I'm sure is not going to be a problem for him. One good game is all it will take to get his confidence up."""

"Fans of %2s celebrated today as Player Manager %1s extended his contract for another season.  The players are equally as happy as they enjoyed last year's season with %1s and are always looking for continuity between each season. ""It just makes a big difference when you already have that team chemistry there, it allows you to focus on other areas that need improving in hopes of a more successful season"" said %1s.  \r\nWith Player Manager %1s staying, fans are at ease, knowing that his expertise on and off the pitch can only help get those wins sooner."

"A handful of leading clubs, including <TeamName3> and <TeamName4>, have emerged as likely candidates for the services of the <PreferredPos1> should he look to confirm recent speculation and seek a move away from <TeamName>.\n<PlayerName> has allegedly been unsettled since arriving at the club and, according to sources close to the player, is ready to consider a move for ""personal reasons"".\nHis current club has so far refused to confirm or deny speculation regarding the player and are not thought have received an official approach from any other team."

"Manager %1s has been given a new opportunity as he has signed a contract with %2s for next season.  \r\n%1s was overheard saying how he wanted a ""fresh start"" with his career and that ""managing %2s will be a great opportunity"".  As far as career decisions go, this seems like the right move for %1s.  ""I felt like I could improve my skills as a Manager with another club"" he said, ""Managing %2s will be a great challenge, and one that I'm up for"" he then added later.\r\nThis should prove to be an interesting season for %2s, one the fans won't forget."

"With the <CompetitionName> Final looming over the football season, <ManagerName> has nothing but praise for his opponents <TeamName2>. ""They are an amazing team, we're humbled to play them given the gulf in quality between the players."" he said. ""I'm sure their manager has got them nicely relaxed, not worrying too much about the massive occasion. I just hope that we can play a part in a great final and help to serve up a cracking game. I know the fans don't like each other too much, but I hope they can put that to one side and enjoy a great day out""."

"A nail biting game turned into one to remember for <TeamName> fans as their players managed to snatch a dramatic late victory against <TeamName2>. ""That was the just reward for the Pressure we exerted in the second half"" said <ManagerName>. ""I always fancied us to nick it, but as time drifts away you wonder if it's not going to be your day. But credit to the lads, they never gave up and got what they deserved."" It was a wonderful finish to an absorbing game, the type of encounter that reminds you why you fell in love with the game in the first place."

"Beating a side with the quality of <TeamName2> represents the perfect opportunity to see just how far <TeamName> have come so far, according to <ManagerName>.\nIn a football magazine article that was published in the lead-up to the two clubs' imminent clash, the manager said: ""We need to judge ourselves against the best and I consider <TeamName2> to be among the best. We certainly have the ability to beat them, but they are a good side and we will be able to tell a lot more about whether our expectation levels are reasonable after we have played them."""

"<ManagerName> has admitted he could do without the distraction of a match against a team the fans love to hate, ahead of the upcoming clash with <TeamName2>, but has said his team know how important the games are and have been in good heart recently.\n""He said: ""I'm sure if you asked <ManagerName2> he would say the same thing. These type of games can be a distraction because they are always so fiercely fought. That said, I could not be more pleased with the guys right now, and we're certain that we'll be taking  <TeamName2> on at a good time for us."" "

<TeamName3> might have the climate to think they could manage to secure the services of <TeamName> <PreferredPos1>, <FullPlayerName>, after the player revealed he would only consider moving to a club in a warmer part of the world.\nOriginally from <Nationality>, <PlayerName> has found it difficult to handle the wetter and colder environment at <TeamName>, and is understood to be considering a premature exit from the club.\n<TeamName> management have refused to confirm or deny the reports, insisting <PlayerName> is a contracted player and, so, going nowhere.

<FullPlayerName> has handed in an official transfer request, ending weeks of speculation that the <TeamName> <PreferredPos1> was homesick and eager to move.\nThe transfer request will come as a blow to manager, <ManagerName>, who recently reassured fans that <PlayerName> would be staying at the club.\nWhere <PlayerName> ends up remains to be seen with several clubs, including <TeamName2> and <TeamName3>, thought to be keen on acquiring his services and testing his resolve. \n\nAfter a disappointing introduction to international football as <TeamName> manager <UserName> turned his fortunes around with an all important victory in his second game in charge. Earn - Playing FIFA 17 earns Experience Points (XP). A match, a new Career, a new player in Creation Centre, it all earns XP.  XP awards span all game modes. XP awards drive your FIFA 17 Level.  More XP = higher levels.  Your current level is shown in the EAS F.C. widget & hub.

Leaderboards - Compare levels & XP to your Friends' via the EAS F.C. leaderboard in the hub. See who's the most passionate FIFA 17 player!

Daily XP Cap - You have a max amount of XP to earn each day.  Once you reach that cap you'll no longer receive XP until the next day.
